item.title: Self-Hosted Kubernetes Resource Templates: cdk8s vs Jsonnet vs KCL
item.description: Managing Kubernetes manifests at scale is one of the most common pain points for platform engineering teams. Raw YAML files quickly become unmanageable as the number of deployments grows — duplication, inconsistent labeling, and configuration drift are inevitable without a templating strategy.
